<span id="what-we-know"></span>
== What we know ==

* The movement takes its form from Occupy Wall Street: no appointed leaders, decisions made in the open. Targets are picked in public.
* Each project lives in its own repository under [https://github.com/occupysaas github.com/occupysaas].
* Spec writers and builders are kept separate by the clean-room firewall (see [[Rules of the road]]).
* Releases need a maintainer’s approval (see [[How we develop]]).
